mirrorReview.notes: Established game-only identity has short purple curls, with no fixed left/right markings, hand-specific prop, or directional emblem. Mirror review preserves the existing portrait identity.

coverage: 35 authored poses across four accurate clips: idle6, dribble8, run13 and dribble-run8. The source has no standing ball-ready drawings, so idle-ball stays on legacy fallback. Every registered clip meets its minimum; dribble and dribble-run remain below target counts.

review.source: All35 separated poses match Dorian’s existing portrait. Full-body packed atlases visually checked on a dark court-color background: idle stances vary, all dribble poses crouch and reach toward the court, running strides alternate, and low turbo-dribble begins with a forward transition then stays low. No crop bleed or clipping.
